description: Implementation of fixed-point trigonometric functions and vector transformations using CORDIC algorithm in the FreeType project.

methods.name: ft_trig_downscale
methods.description: Multiplies a fixed-point value by the CORDIC shrink factor, optimized for 64-bit or 32-bit architectures.

methods.name: ft_trig_prenorm
methods.description: Pre-normalizes a vector to ensure safe fixed-point operations, returning the shift applied.

methods.name: ft_trig_pseudo_rotate
methods.description: Rotates a vector by a given angle using pseudo-rotation with right shifts.

methods.name: ft_trig_pseudo_polarize
methods.description: Converts a vector into polar coordinates (length and angle) using pseudo-rotation.
